note: Responsive Menus attaches a JS 'style' (a @ResponsiveMenus plugin) to CSS/jQuery selectors to make menus mobile-friendly. Settings form route responsive_menus.admin (permission 'administer responsive menus') writes config object responsive_menus.configuration with keys style (default responsive_menus_simple), ignore_admin (default true), style_settings (per-style map). Shipped enabled styles: responsive_menus_simple, mean_menu. Plugin manager plugin.manager.responsive_menus, annotation Drupal\responsive_menus\Annotation\ResponsiveMenus. Medium reads back a customized active style; hard switches the active style to mean_menu and is verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the responsive_menus module, which config object stores its settings, what is the config key for the active menu style, and what is the default style?
evals.expected_output: Config object responsive_menus.configuration holds the settings; the active style is the 'style' key, defaulting to responsive_menus_simple (the 'Simple expanding' style). Other keys: ignore_admin (default true) and style_settings.

evals.prompt: How do I add my own responsive menu style to the responsive_menus module in Drupal 10/11? Which plugin type / annotation and manager are involved?
evals.expected_output: Create a plugin in your module's Plugin/ResponsiveMenus/ namespace with the @ResponsiveMenus annotation (id, label, library), extending ResponsiveMenusPluginBase; it is discovered by plugin.manager.responsive_menus. Implement defaultSettings(), settingsForm(), and getJsSettings(). (Legacy: hook_responsive_menus_style_info / hook_responsive_menus_styles_alter.)

evals.prompt: Which responsive menu styles ship ready-to-use with the responsive_menus module without downloading extra libraries?
evals.expected_output: Two styles ship enabled: 'Simple expanding' (responsive_menus_simple, the default) and 'Mean Menu' (mean_menu). Sidr, codrops Multi-level, Google Nexus, and Multi-level Push Menu require downloading their external libraries.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Responsive Menus module has been configured with a non-default style. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which responsive menu style is currently active.
evals.expected_output: The active style is mean_menu (Mean Menu), stored at responsive_menus.configuration -> style (drush cget responsive_menus.configuration style).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Responsive Menus module to use the Mean Menu style instead of the default. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: responsive_menus.configuration -> style is set to mean_menu (drush cset responsive_menus.configuration style mean_menu -y).
